current_static_findings.evidence: RPC返回Ok后先删除整个LocalCache条目，未检查response.rejected或rejected_ids
current_static_findings.consequence: 缓存重放中的部分拒绝事件被永久删除，无法按原event_id恢复

current_static_findings.evidence: RPC返回Ok时events_sent增加整个batch_size，rejected只计指标且不回写WAL
current_static_findings.consequence: 首次发送的partial ACK被当作整批成功，拒绝项不会进入重试或隔离

current_static_findings.evidence: LocalCache仅在连接或RPC失败后写入，网络发送前没有durable write-ahead barrier
current_static_findings.consequence: 取出batch到失败缓存之间的进程崩溃窗口可丢整批Flow事件

current_static_findings.evidence: proto.Marshal失败只continue；只要函数最终返回nil，上层无法得知被跳过的输入位置
current_static_findings.consequence: 未进入Kafka的事件仍可能被Handler计为accepted并提交dedup标记

current_static_findings.evidence: Kafka失败被编码为UploadFlowsResponse且RPC返回nil error；非空header tenant/probe未与认证上下文比较
current_static_findings.consequence: 旧Agent可能删除整批，且认证为A的探针可提交带B身份的Flow header

current_static_findings.evidence: dedup key仅使用event_id，IsDuplicate与MarkSeenBatch分离且Redis Exists/Set不是原子claim
current_static_findings.consequence: 跨租户同event_id可误去重，同批或并发请求可同时miss并重复写Kafka

dispositions.name: DUPLICATE_COMMITTED
dispositions.client_action: delete the exact WAL item without republishing

dispositions.name: REJECTED_INVALID
dispositions.client_action: move the exact item to typed quarantine with reason code

dispositions.name: RETRYABLE
dispositions.client_action: retain event identity and schedule bounded retry

dispositions.name: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
dispositions.client_action: release lease and retry the same logical event identity

transitions.durability_barrier: sled transaction and flush complete before scheduling
claim revision and lease stored atomically
one transaction removes terminal items and retains nonterminal items
batch index removed only after item exact-set is empty
reason-coded quarantine record flushed before WAL deletion
original event bytes and identity remain durable
attempt budget and next-attempt time persist
accepted items cannot reappear after crash

invariants: no network send occurs before every item has a durable WAL identity
only KAFKA_ACKED and DUPLICATE_COMMITTED count as accepted terminal success
an ACK response must exactly partition the submitted event identity set with no missing duplicate or foreign IDs
WAL item deletion and retained-item rewrite are one atomic transaction followed by flush
transport timeout or cancellation is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than deterministic rejection
dedup identity is tenant_id plus probe_id plus event_id and is committed only after Kafka ACK

function_contracts.responsibility: 在任何网络发送前原子持久化batch及逐event identity并返回稳定WAL引用
body_steps: B01 validate non-empty batch and unique non-empty event IDs
B02 compute canonical batch UUID and per-item payload hashes without wall-clock key identity
B03 start sled transaction and enforce atomic byte and item capacity limits
B04 insert batch metadata item bytes retry revision and state DURABLE_READY
B05 flush durability and return CachedBatchRef only after success
error_branches: empty or duplicate event identity returns deterministic invalid input
capacity or disk failure returns backpressure and schedules nothing
transaction or flush failure leaves no visible sendable ref
function_contracts.atomicity: batch metadata and all item records become visible together; no partial batch is claimable
function_contracts.idempotency: the same explicit batch ID and same item hashes returns the existing ref; same ID with different bytes conflicts
function_contracts.rollback: disable WAL producer scheduling, retain every durable entry, and restore the old reader only after a compatibility scanner proves no new-format pending entries

B02 reject missing duplicate foreign or revision-mismatched ACK identities
B03 partition terminal accepted terminal invalid retryable and unknown items
B04 transactionally write quarantine remove terminal items and rewrite remaining batch
B05 flush and return counts plus next state
error_branches: ACK exact-set mismatch retains the full claimed batch and emits protocol violation
flush failure leaves prior durable state replayable
invalid reason without stable code rejects the ACK application
function_contracts.atomicity: accepted deletion quarantine creation and rejected-item rewrite commit in one sled transaction
function_contracts.idempotency: reapplying the same response revision yields the stored AckApplication without deleting additional items
function_contracts.rollback: stop applying new ACKs and preserve the WAL; never restore whole-batch remove while any mixed-disposition entry exists

function_contracts.responsibility: 先持久化再有界claim发送，并仅按逐item disposition推进WAL与指标
outputs: () with every item terminal or durable pending
body_steps: B01 persist batch through LocalCache::save before acquiring a network permit
B02 claim the durable ref with lease and acquire bounded in-flight permit
B03 connect and send only the claimed immutable bytes
B04 classify response exact-set and call LocalCache::apply_ack
B05 count only terminal dispositions and release retryable or unknown claims
error_branches: WAL failure applies upstream backpressure and performs no send
connect or RPC failure releases the claim without duplicating the entry
protocol-invalid ACK retains the whole claim and disconnects
function_contracts.atomicity: network I/O is outside sled transaction; WAL claim and ACK application are separate durable state transitions
function_contracts.idempotency: retries reuse the same event IDs and payload hashes; Gateway duplicate committed is terminal success
function_contracts.rollback: stop intake, keep all durable refs, drain old-compatible claimed entries, then restore the previous sender without deleting new-format WAL data

function_contracts.signature_before: async fn send_stream(&self, events: Vec<FlowEvent>) -> Result<(u32, u32)>

body_steps: B01 verify claim lease revision and bounded item count
B02 build stream from immutable claimed event bytes
B03 collect one typed disposition per submitted event identity
B04 treat stream interruption and missing responses as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
B05 apply exact-set ACK transaction and return terminal pending counts
error_branches: foreign or duplicate response identity is protocol violation
stream interruption retains every nonterminal item
deadline expiration releases claim as outcome unknown
function_contracts.atomicity: each remote response is buffered until the full submitted identity set can be validated and applied atomically
function_contracts.idempotency: accepted and duplicate committed items cannot reappear after ACK transaction flush
function_contracts.rollback: disable streaming and route durable refs through the compatible unary detailed-ACK path; preserve all nonterminal WAL entries

function_contracts.responsibility: 按稳定顺序和attempt预算claim durable refs，应用逐item ACK，绝不因RPC Ok删除整批
outputs: durable WAL state transitions and bounded metrics
body_steps: B01 enumerate eligible durable refs in stable order with bounded limit
B02 claim one ref with lease revision and check cancellation
B03 send claimed bytes through the selected unary or stream path
B04 apply typed ACK or release retryable and unknown items
B05 move exhausted permanent failures to durable quarantine and continue healthy refs

transport error releases the current claim and disconnects
shutdown keeps every unfinished item durable
function_contracts.atomicity: each claim and ACK application is independently durable; retry loop owns no cross-entry transaction
function_contracts.idempotency: attempts never manufacture a new event ID or batch identity and never resend terminal items
function_contracts.rollback: stop retry worker, leave claims to expire into durable ready state, and do not run the old whole-batch remove path
